interpretation.sixKPassDefinition: full intended steady workload produced, admitted, and delivered; zero count/byte gaps; every admitted source event delivered exactly once; FIFO; fairness progress; and drain completion
interpretation.producerRateDefinition: actualProducerRatePerSec is workloadEventsAttempted divided by steady workload duration; initial book and partial-queue setup events are excluded
interpretation.fairnessLimitation: The local periodic timer detects event-loop starvation only; OVH production soak remains the network fairness proof.
interpretation.sustainedHarnessLimitation: scripts/sustained-capacity-harness.ts is not used as scheduler-capacity evidence because it uses ScriptedBoundedMarketTransport.
interpretation.sourceUnitLimitation: The approximately 6k Stage-0 production observation was normalized snapshots/sec; this harness calibrates source events/sec, which are not identical units.
interpretation.finalistDefinition: 5-second 6k source-event burst tolerance; a bounded backlog that drains after producer stop passes the burst check, but this is not indefinite sustainable throughput.

recommendation.basis: No finalist completed all repeated corrected-data checks; no OVH soak candidate selected.
